messages:
sara: customer escalated — after we onboarded duckbill-v1 they see p99 jump from ~600ms to 9-28s on long docs (~20k-30k chars). Some requests hit 504. They say it started right after the model cutover. sample payload attached (long doc + chat config).
sara: here is a minimal repro curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' 
 -d '{"model":"duckbill-v1","input":"<20k chars>"}'
```
matt: looking. assigning to eng-runtime oncall. can you paste the request id / example response with timings?
sara: request-id: r-0a7f3c5b, customer log shows: 1) 200 on some requests (~700ms) 2) 504 after ~30s 3) intermittent 10-25s p99. They also noticed auth retries happening right before some 504s.
cs-jordan: customer billing flagged some replays ~3k tokens billed twice in a window, could be retries. adding to the ticket.
ingrid: quick hypothesis: duckbill-v1 switched tokenizer backend to the new utf8-normalizer which hits the slow-path for long multibyte clusters (emoji, CJK), complexity becomes O(n*m) in degenerate sequences and triggers KV cache churn for long contexts. will try to repro locally.
matt: can you repro in staging with their payload? if it's tokenizer slow-path we should see CPU spike + single-threaded stall before serving.
ingrid: repro confirmed in my local run — CPU trace shows long single-thread parse in tokenization phase, not GPU time. sample log snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T14:11:02Z] tokenization:start req=r-0a7f3c5b 
[2026-03-12T14:11:32Z] tokenization:end   time=30.2s tokens=18k path=utf8-slowpath
```
ingrid: also noticed that the tokenizer returns many subword splits which increases KV cache insertions and leads to cache eviction churn downstream.
kai: ok actionable mitigation options: 1) route affected customers to duckbill-v1-legacy (old tokenizer) 2) apply a quick patch to tokenizer to detect long multibyte blocks and switch to fast byte-level fallback 3) rate-limit/shorten max_input_length for this model temporarily 4) enable stronger prefix cache retention for customer's org to avoid repeated full tokenizations.
matt: prefer (1) + (2) for short term. route rule can be pushed as config change. (2) needs a small patch but should be low-risk. canary plan?
ingrid: I can patch tokenizer with a guard: if input length > 8k and >40% multibyte runs then use byte-fallback. small unit tests added. will open PR.
matt: create a canary in us-west-2 with 10% traffic and monitor p95/p99. deploy-bot, kickoff canary.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for service=tokenizer on infra:us-west-2 by user=matt, change=tokenizer-utf8-fallback-20260312, target=10%
matt: oncall will watch latency dashboards + traces. Sara — please tell customer we have a mitigation: temporary routing and patch queued.
sara: updating customer: "we've identified a tokenizer slow-path on long multibyte inputs after the new tokenizer rollout. We can route you to a legacy tokenizer immediately and we'll roll a tested fix in canary today."
cs-jordan: flagged billing team to reverse duplicate replays for the affected window and to check retry logic — looks like some clients retried on 504 causing double billing.
ingrid: PR opened: r/1234, tests included, CI green. requesting review from matt.
matt: reviewed, lgtm. promote canary to 30% after 30m if p99 < 2s.
deploy-bot: canary update: tokenizer canary bumped to 30% by user=matt
kai: longer-term: add a pre-tokenize heuristic in the ingest path to detect degenerate multibyte clusters and rewrite/summarize long blocks or fail fast with 413-like error to avoid tanking inference. creating a backlog ticket.
sara: customer replied: accepts routing to legacy. asked for ETA on permanent fix. i gave tentative "within 24 hours" and asked if they want credits for duplicates.
matt: good. assigning postmortem champ (ingrid) and follow-up action items on runbook: add tokenization slowpath alert, add test corpora with long multibyte examples, and add opt-out routing knobs.
ingrid: will own postmortem + remediation. assigning JIRA INF-9821.
sara: closing loop with customer now. will update thread when billing reversal done. :thumbsup:
